winText: Shuffle up. DECK was the pivot - a backyard platform to a set of playing CARDS.
lossText: CARDS - the paper pieces used in games. DECK was the pivot: a DECK is a wooden platform behind a house, but a DECK is also a full set of 52 playing CARDS.
